verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents a dedicated Pay by Bank / Payments API v3 product for making and accepting payments. Its docs cover authentication, request signing, webhooks, testing and SDKs, plus mandate-based recurring payments (VRP and Direct Debit). Geographies are stated as UK and EU, with a providers endpoint listing supported banks per European country. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of live payment initiation, and an explicit per-country list of live markets in the docs rather than one delegated to an API query.
